description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, family-owned and operating since 1928, known for burgers made with fresh Canadian beef, locally sourced BC chicken, and crowd-pleasing classics. The brand also operates Triple O's as a fast-casual sub-brand, and this OSM node appears to reference one of its many Vancouver-area locations. A touring cyclist would find reliable indoor seating, a broad menu including vegetarian options, and takeout availability.
